title: NuTrea: Neural Tree Search for Context-guided Multi-hop KGQA
summary: This community centers on the 2023 paper 'NuTrea: Neural Tree Search for Contextguided Multi-hop KGQA' and its four co-authors. The work proposes a neural tree search approach specifically designed to handle multi-hop question answering over knowledge graphs. The cluster is defined by the authorship relationships linking Hyeong Kyu Choi, Seunghun Lee, Jaewon Chu, and Hyunwoo J. Kim to this specific publication.
